findings.evidence: `Matrix.vecCons` is a plain def: `def vecCons {n : ℕ} (h : α) (t : Fin n → α) : Fin n.succ → α := Fin.cons h t` (upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Data/Fin/VecNotation.lean:61), so `rw [Matrix.vecCons]` is definitional unfolding via the equation lemma, not a rewrite over API. `Fin.cons_update` is `@[simp]` (upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Data/Fin/Tuple/Basic.lean:143-144).
findings.fix: Drop the `Matrix.vecCons` unfoldings in favour of the tuple simp set (`Fin.cons_update` is `@[simp]`, as are `Matrix.cons_val_zero`/`cons_val_succ`) plus `f.map_update_neg`, e.g. a single `simp only [...]`; if the `← hcons` round-trip is genuinely unavoidable, add a one-line comment saying why `Function.update_eq_self` needs the argument in cons form.
findings.issue: `bilinMap_update_neg` is an 8-lemma `rw` chain that delta-unfolds `Matrix.vecCons` four times (lines 101 and 105) to expose the `Fin.cons` layer, with no comment on why the `vecCons` API cannot reach the goal; the closing `rw [← hcons, Function.update_eq_self]` rewrites `m i` *back* into the cons tuple, which is unexplained.

findings.evidence: upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Determinant/Basic.lean:806-810 and 817-826 both close the analogous 2×2/3×3 expansions with `simp only [...]` followed by `ring`.
findings.fix: Use `simp only [...]` with the explicit lemma list in both places, matching Mathlib's own `det_fin_two`/`det_fin_three`.
findings.issue: Non-terminal full `simp` whose output shape `ring` depends on: `simp (disch := decide) [...]` then `ring` (lines 43-45). Any upstream simp-set change can alter the residual goal so `ring` fails or errors with "no goals". Same pattern at `QFT/Scattering/DIS/Polarized/Tensor.lean:384-386` (`simp [...]` then `ring` in `ηWit_apply`).

findings.evidence: `Matrix.mulVec_diagonal` exists (upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Data/Matrix/Mul.lean:752) and `Fin.sum_univ_four` is used throughout Mathlib; `EpsilonEridani/QFT/Lattice/Continuation/Basic.lean:95-96` already evaluates a Minkowski `toBilin'` via `Matrix.mulVec_diagonal` rather than unfolding `Matrix.diagonal`.
findings.fix: Replace with `simp only [ηWit, Matrix.toBilin'_apply', Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_four, ...]` and keep `ring` only if still needed — the idiom already used elsewhere in this repo.
findings.issue: `ηWit_apply` puts the definitions `Matrix.mulVec` and `Matrix.diagonal` into the simp set, unfolding structure definitions instead of using the existing lemmas; it also uses `Fin.sum_univ_succ` where the closed form exists.

summary: Proofs are mostly short and robust, but `bilinMap_update_neg` rests on an undocumented delta-unfolding of `Matrix.vecCons` inside a long `rw` chain, and two proofs end in a non-terminal full `simp` followed by `ring`, one of which also unfolds `Matrix.diagonal`/`Matrix.mulVec` as definitions where named lemmas exist.
